RFC 3161 verification, separate explicit TSA roots, historical certificate validity, library timestamp providers and nonce-bound SHA-256 exchanges are implemented. A public-test RSA arm64 signature exactly replays a recorded native Apple token; Apple and OpenSSL acceptance are exercised. The CLI signs with online HTTP --timestamp[=URL], verifies and displays timestamps, and supports --timestamp=none. Bundled Apple roots are explicit TSA inputs. A bounded pure-Go HTTP transport is exercised against a local authority on all targets; opt-in live Apple acceptance covers three Mach-O forms. Full TSA/Apple policy, proxy/redirect behavior, revocation, general CMS/BER and localized dates remain incomplete.

RSA/ECDSA PEM and authenticated PKCS#12 signing, native allocation, Apple BER CMS/hash agility, leaf pins and portable explicit-CA chain policy are implemented. The existing 64-case matrix is supplemented by three organization-anchor comparisons, a Developer ID csreq comparison, 24 native PKCS#12 signatures and real public Developer ID chain/Team ID checks. Authorities, fixed-format signing-time and RFC 3161 timestamp metadata are displayed. Timestamp callbacks and separate TSA trust add native replay evidence. Full PKIX/Apple policy, localized dates, end-to-end Developer ID signing, broader TSA transport policy, hybrid algorithms and revocation remain incomplete.

Contents-based APPL bundles with XML/binary Info.plist and plain resources support signing, inspection, verification and removal. Deterministic v1/v2 CodeResources and executable special slots bind original metadata/resource bytes; XML/binary envelope verification uses the supported rules. Binary graphs enforce offset, reference, depth, expansion, Unicode and duplicate/cycle checks. The XML matrix is supplemented by six binary native executable/envelope comparisons, thirty display comparisons, twelve ad-hoc/RSA apps across two encoders, four metadata mutations and binary-envelope acceptance. Three binary native fixtures and twelve exported apps per Linux/Windows producer extend CI. Nested code, frameworks, symlinks/xattrs, wider discovery, custom rules and full strict/diagnostic parity remain incomplete. See docs/bundles.md for conservative type, path, layout and size limits.

A pinned direct go-apfs-v2/pkg/disk dependency supplies DMGFooter. Single-segment UDIF v4 signing, inspection and verification preserve payload bytes and bind the canonical trailer in slot 6. Forty ad-hoc native byte/display comparisons, fifteen ad-hoc/RSA/P-256 native signature and hdiutil checks, five native fixtures, matched-time RSA equality, local TSA tests and a live Apple timestamp establish the tested profile. Native-unsupported removal returns an error without mutation. Encrypted/segmented images, large-image streaming, detached signatures, additional digests, stapled-ticket/notarization policy and full option/diagnostic parity remain incomplete.
macOS 27 hybrid signatures and detached certificates remain incomplete.
Extended-attribute and non-Mach-O signed representations remain incomplete.
SHA-1 and alternate digest writing, scatter pages, and legacy architecture acceptance remain incomplete.
